The common first-year core for engineering students in Kenya, in plain words, with worked examples in SI units — every bubble linked to a free textbook page (OpenStax University Physics) or Wikipedia. Four maps so far (units and dimensions; vectors and trigonometry; statics; dynamics with Newton's second law); a new map is added on Saturdays.
